notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Elves.
description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Elvish Archdruid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Elvish Archdruid.
Repeat.
